failed_products.retailer_description: The Yerba Prima Tampico Skin Brush is a wonderful, revitalizing health and beauty aid. Removing the top layer of dead skin and stimulating the circulation of blood feeding the skin are essential for maintaining youthful, glowing and supple skin. Skin Brushing has been used throughout the world for centuries, and is making its way back into popularity. Dry skin brushing is one of the best ways to cleanse the skin without removing the protective mantle of acid and oils. It gently and effectively removes the top layer of dead skin cells with its build-up of dirt and acid, and deeply cleanses the pores. Skin brushing is one of the most powerful ways to cleanse the lymphatic system. Waste material is carried away from the cells by the blood and the lymph. Skin brushing stimulates the release of this material from the cells near the surface of the body. Eventually, most of the toxins along with their carrier cells, primarily lymphocytes, find their way to the colon for elimination. Skin brushing is also used by beauty salons as part of a program for removing cellulite. Skin brushing is most effective with an all-natural vegetable fiber brush, such as the Tampico Skin Brush. Make sure the brush isn t made of synthetic fiber since this can irritate the skin. A long handle is also helpful for reaching the back and entire body.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Annie’s Cheddar Mac (as we call it!) is our answer to all those chemically orange colored cheeses out there. We’ve taken our original Shells & White Cheddar and added a little color to it, naturally! Our totally natural cheese is colored with a plant extract called annatto. Annatto has been used in tropical American cultures for generations to color foods such as butter, cheese and mustard. The annatto tree grows 20 to 30 feet in height and when its seeds are stirred in water, they produce orange annatto dye, also called achiote, to color foods. Annie’s Cheddar Macaroni and cheese is a great alternative for kids who need to have that “orange” cheese on their macaroni.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: bionaturæ organic Fruit Spreads are produced using hand-harvested heirloom varieties of fruit from select regions of Italy. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: From vineyard to bottling, Special Cuvée sees such an extraordinary level of care and attention, it is difficult to place within the non-vintage or, really, any Champagne category. It is a Champagne that stands apart.  Within one bottle, all the complexity of flavor, texture and pleasure that Champagne can offer.  Special Cuvée is truly a journey of devotion from Bollinger.  Bollinger is the producer most associated with a single grape variety in Champagne, namely Pinot Noir. This more difficult grape to grow makes up a minimum of 60% of all of Bollinger’s Champagne. The harmony of Pinot Noir’s richness and elegance plays a large part in Special Cuvée’s distinct profile, the ripe red berries and powerful impact a clear signature. Then there is the other association that Bollinger is so well known for: winemaking in barrel. As virtually every Champagne producer in the latter half of the 20th century moved to fermenting in large lots in stainless steel tanks, Bollinger persisted to oversee fermentation barrel by barrel for all vintage Champagnes and a remarkable 30% of Special Cuvée. Why? Because the development of flavors becomes so much more complex, and the texture rounder and silkier. A third Bollinger specialty is the aging of Champagnes. Most Champagnes on the market are primarily made up of the most recently harvested vintage before requirements to age in bottle. Bollinger is primarily made up of Champagnes that are not from the most recent vintage, and in the end a newly released bottle of Bollinger is around 7-8 years old. A fourth – and utterly distinct – practice at Bollinger is the use of Reserve Magnums. The best vineyards will be aged under cork in magnum for up to 15 years, and hand disgorged into the final blend to bring the aromas and flavors only a great aged Champagne can display, notes such as truffles, ginger and walnut. So you have it all: the freshness that Champagne brings naturally, the secondary notes as the fruit character becomes riper and savory and spicy notes enter, and the third level, when fruit becomes almost crystallized, texture becomes like velvet, and the glass in front of you brings meaning to you and with those you have chosen to share. Special Cuvée does all of this for you.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Coconut Amino make a great substitute for soy sauces. Coconut Amino have many benefits over soy-based sauces, including 14 times the amino acid content. Many soy sauces on the market are fermented by first soaking the soybeans in water and salt, and then adding specific cultures of molds, yeasts and bacteria to help catalyze the fermentation process. Coconut Amino is made from coconut tree sap, which comes right out of the tree so that vital, active and alive nutrients are blended with sun dried mineral-rich sea salt and aged, without the need for a fermentation booster or added water. Health Secrets of Coconut Amino: When the coconut tree is tapped, it produces a highly nutrient-rich "sap" that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This sap is very low glycemic (GI of only 35), is an abundant source of amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral PH The "Gran Moluccas Sea Salt" used in our Coconut Amino, garners its name from the exotic, tropical island of Mindanao, the 2nd largest island in the Philippines. A local culinary heritage in Mindanao, this unbleached, unrefined, naturally white sea salt, is fed only by the sun and the sea. It is hand-harvested by local salt producers working as their forefathers did, in their ancestral salt fields. Recipe Tips: Use Coconut Amino like soy sauce in dressings, marinades, sautés, and with sushi. Refrigerate after opening. "We love it so much we pour it over almost everything!" Coconut Amigos seasoning sauce is gluten free, contains 65% less sodium than soy sauce, is USDA organic, vegan and non-go.

Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes. Buon Appetito! Fusilli come from Campania and belong to the short, straight cut family of pasta. In the past, Fusilli were made by hand according to a method that was passed down from one generation to the next. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Frankincense HydroSoul is an outstanding facial tonic for firming and toning wrinkles and fine lines, offering an instant "lift" to sagging facial muscles while also supplying the senses with a soothing and ethereal aroma: slightly sweet and peppery with undertones of resinous woods & truly the fragrance of the ancients. Frankincense has been used for thousands of years, and has been considered sacred to all cultures that encountered it. It's been found in beauty balms in the tombs of Ancient Egyptian Pharaohs, burned as incense in innumerable temples and churches to sanctify the space and summon Divine presence, and used as a tool in meditation, prayer and purification rituals. In the ancient world, pathways were forged in the desert to circulate this sacred plant through the spice trade. At that time, it was worth more than its weight in gold. It is protective, purifying, and fortifying for all skin and spirits. Distilled from the dried sap tears of the desert tree Boswellia Carterii, Frankincense is a powerful skin ally, like many desert plants are. Frankincense has an amazing ability to deeply beautify, hydrate, and rejuvenating the skin. This sacred water is a must in every collection. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our Lavender Facial Tonic Hydrosol is sourced from a few small, organic farms. It is distilled solely for its hydrophilic (water-loving) components, not the essential oil. Distillers of essential oils usually use plant material that has been dried over several days, resulting in a loss of approximately 70% of water volume. We choose to distill for the hydrosol alone and use only fresh plant material. In this way the resulting hydrosol is much richer in the valuable, water-soluble aromatic molecules. Furthermore, these hydrosols are artisan-distilled at low temperatures for over two to three hours. Conventional distillation utilizes high temperatures, and the process lasts for only thirty to forty-five minutes. The more labor-intensive artisan process that we choose to use creates a hydrosol that is vitalizing and healing for all skin conditions. Pure plant hydrosols are some of nature's best antioxidants. Saturating the skin daily with these precious waters restores pH balance, refreshes and tones skin tissue, maintaining soft and smooth skin while significantly increasing vitality and hydration to all skin conditions. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our Rosehip Balancing Serum is beneficial for all types of skin. Known as rosa rubiginosa or rosa mosqueta, this silky oil of the rose hip seed has been used for centuries by the indigenous people of the Chilean Andes to treat burned, sun-damaged or scarred skin. Rosehip seed oil is rich in the naturally occurring pro-vitamin A and vitamin C. It has considerable amounts of polyunsaturated essential fatty acids (EFA) containing 80% gamma linolenic acid and linoleic acid. As a result it significantly regenerates and strengthens cell membranes aiding in the prevention of early signs of aging. Used on a consistent basis, your skin will look smoother, fresher and more supple. Precious essential oils of rose geranium, sandalwood, rose otto & carrot seed are added to enhance the action of the rosehip seed oil. Their tiny molecular size and lipophilic (oil-loving) tendency make them ideal for curative skin treatments. Ingredients: Rosehip Seed (Rosa canina) Fruit Oil*, Jojoba (Simmondsia chinensis) Seed Oil*, Rose Geranium (Pelargonium graveolens) Oil*, Carrot (Daucus carota) Seed Essential Oil*, Hawaiian Sandalwood (Santalum paniculatum) Wood Oil*, Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Flower Oil*, Rose Otto (Rosa damascena) Flower Oil*, Vitamin E (Tocopherol) *ORGANIC How to use: Use oil serum & HydroSoul together. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: California Olive Ranch’s globally inspired, Destination Series is a celebration of high quality high-quality extra virgin olive oil produced around the world. The olives are proudly grown and harvested by our partner growers in Argentina, Chile, Portugal, and our California farmers, and are expertly blended in California to create the ideal taste profile. This Olive Oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This gourmet EVOO features well-rounded tasty notes of fresh herbs, fruit and green grass. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.

These long lasting tea lights candles hold their own on a dinner table or under a wax warmer. They sit in standard tea-light holders for everyday indoor home ambiance, and their neutral flame suits Shabbat, prayer, and altar tables. Crafters reach for them as a gentle heat source for wax-seal stamping. As a clean-burning cross-shopper pick for soy tealight candles buyers, they deliver the neutral burn without the soy. This 400 count case is the bulk pack: enough white tea lights for weddings, hosting, and fragrance-free dinner settings, so you are never caught short. Every cup is recyclable aluminum, every box is recyclable paperboard printed with vegetable-based inks, and every purchase supports the sustainable palm oil movement. A clean, honest choice for your home. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: THE HEADBAND | This twist headband for men is a top seller and for good reason. For starters, it's made from ridiculously soft, sweat-wicking and breathable organic cotton. A warning: once you go organic, you'll never be able to wear a synthetic (read: plastic) headband again. Second, it works. We designed the sweatband with a twist that sits at the nape of the neck, keeping the headband from slipping during even the sweatiest workout. This design, coupled with the sweat-wicking organic cotton, means no more headband slipping during your workouts. Third, it's versatile. Choose to wear the headband thin like a tennis headband, scrunched for a rocker-headband or opened wide for a full bandana head covering, Last but not least, it's ethically made. Read more about this last point in the "About KOOSHOO" section below. MATERIALS | The body of this twist headwrap is made from 93% organic cotton and 7% spandex. ABOUT KOOSHOO | KOOSHOO is an eco-friendly clothing and accessories brand created by husband and wife yoga teachers to help others feel good (KOOSHOO literally means "feeling good"). We make organic headbands, the world's ONLY plastic-free hairties, stylish shawls and baby plants that grow with a child. We always use the finest organic and natural materials, ethically manufacture in certified facilities, dye using low-impact azo-free dyes and package in 100% recycled and/or biodegradable packaging. We're a small business run by real people that care deeply about our customers, suppliers and the environment. We stand 100% behind our products (full refunds and/or exchanges if not stoked) and every time a sale is made, the team does a happy dance in honor of the customer.

Grown with earth-preserving practices, our 20+ rice and quinoa varieties are cultivated to maximize the flavor of each tiny grain. Long, short, black, brown, white, red, and blended. Each variety brings something different to the table so you can get creative in the kitchen. Enjoy the whole-grain goodness of our Lundberg Organic Alfredo Risotto. Try this world famous fla­vor of Béchamel sauce in this ele­gant Ital­ian-style risot­to. We cre­at­ed this deli­cious gourmet side dish by blend­ing qual­i­ty organ­ic ingre­di­ents like Parme­san cheese, gar­lic, onion, and pars­ley with our creamy Arbo­rio rice. Prepar­ing this tasty risot­to takes about 20 min­utes and requires min­i­mal stir­ring. It’s an easy, con­ve­nient way to add gourmet flair to any meal. Hungry for more? Look for other great-tasting side dishes, entrees, snacks, and packaged rice and quinoa varieties from Lundberg Family Farms. Good from the grain up!

Cloudberry - A revered Nordic berry notorious for its ability to grow in the harshest of conditions, Cloudberry is packed with rejuvenating antioxidants such as vitamin C & beta carotene that help even the complexion and brighten! Turmeric extract - A powerhouse antioxidant great for acne-prone skin, turmeric extract helps lighten the appearance of skin discoloration and provide antioxidant protection. Chaga - A natural adaptogen packed with powerful antioxidants including superoxide dismutase and zinc. Works to rejuvenate and protect the skin from daily stressors and exposure to pollutants. Shea Butter - Used in Africa for centuries for its moisturizing & soothing properties, shea butter is a rich source of the powerful antioxidants vitamin A & E, crucial fatty acids and cinnamic acid. Ceramide - Forms a thin lipid barrier that holds in moisture, while protecting & nourishing the skin.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: A gentle, creamy body wash infused with Goat's Milk, Shea Butter, Chai, and Rose Extracts, that cleanses while keeping skin feeling hydrated and soft to reveal a radiant look. This Body cleanser lathers and diffuses elegant and floral notes for a soothing ambiance. Heritage: Ancient images of roses on Egyptian and Abyssinian tomb walls date back to 500 BC. Inspired by the softening rose and milk baths of Cleopatra, this modern interpretation highlights these well-documented skincare additives. Chai, the word for tea in Swahili, is integral to the cultural and social fabric of many civilizations. Rich in antioxidants, Chai helps nourish the skin to maintain a more youthful looking appearance. Usage instructions: Apply this body and face wash to a washcloth or hands and work into a lather to cleanse the entire body. Rinse completely. Humble Beginnings: Nubian Heritage has been guided by the legacy of ancient Nubia, the world's first melting pot. Ancient Nubia was once a center of cultural trade - a place where goods, ideas, and customs from across Africa, Asia, the Middle East and the Mediterranean came together, influenced each other, and then spread across the ancient world. That is our inspiration.

Fragrant Patchouli Oil works to uplift and soothe the senses while Shea Butter and Rosehip Seed Oil combine to cleanse the skin without drying. Leave skin soft and renewed.Humble BeginningsNubian Heritage is the brainchild of two New York street vendors. In 1992, fresh out of college and without jobs, Rich and Nyema embarked on a mission to produce luxurious natural products from traditional African recipes with fair trade ingredients. Today Nubian Heritage offers culturally authentic natural products inspired by global ancient healing philosophies. Although Nubian Heritage products are no longer made in bath tubs, little else has changed; the company still makes its products, still uses fair trade ingredients and still invests in community commerce.HeritageA time honored Asian beauty secret, Patchouli relaxes and soothes the senses while Buriti Oil, made from the fruit of Buriti Palm, known as the "tree of life", hydrates and rejuvenates skin's appearance. Emphasizing the ingredients' brightening properties, our package symbolizes happiness and is representative of Thailands' textile industry, which economically empowers countless communities and employs over one million individuals.Manufactured in the USA with ethically sourced ingredients around the world.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Nutiva Organic Liquid Coconut Oil is rich in MCTs, making it a nourishing and versatile great food for cooking, baking, and beauty. Unlike other oils on the market, Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil is never processed using hexane or other dangerous chemicals. At Nutiva, we start with organic, non-GMO Southeast Asian coconuts, sustainably harvested and immediately cold pressed to naturally extract the fresh, flavorful coconut oil. Next, Nutiva uses a USDA certified organic process to extract the fats from the virgin coconut oil that remain solid at room temperature, resulting in an oil that remains liquid, even at cooler temperatures. The neutral flavor makes it great for sautéing, baking, or enhancing your favorite recipes. It's ideal as a medium-heat cooking oil, a nutritious substitute in baking and is an excellent alternative to olive oil. It’s also a wholesome addition to vegetarian, vegan, raw, whole food, paleo-friendly, ketogenic, and gluten-free diets. The purity and nutrient density of Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil make it good for you both inside and out. Use the luscious, soothing oil as a natural skin moisturizer, eye make-up remover, deep conditioning hair treatment, or combine it with Nutiva Coconut Sugar and your favorite essential oil for an exfoliating, refreshing body scrub. Nutiva was founded in 1999 with a single purpose in mind - to Revolutionize the Way the World Eats. We produce organic, nutrient-dense foods that are good for you and good for the planet. Social and environmental responsibility is a core part of Nutiva’s culture and business. We are dedicated to sourcing organic products, obtaining fair trade certification, greening our facilities and operations, and funding tree planting at schools in our local community; we are constantly seeking ways to better protect our environment and ensure a better quality of life for employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Slippery Elm Bark, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: In our family, a dinner party is not complete without tortilla chips, salsa, and guacamole. Our grain free chips are dairy-free, powered by avocado oil, and made with natural ingredients (and lots of love!). With a selection of flavors like Sea Salt, Lime, Nacho, Fuego, Ranch, Sal y Limón, and No Salt, we hope there’s a flavor that speaks to everyone. Delicious as a solo act or in queso, bean dip, or hot sauce—but the real magic is when our tortilla chips are enjoyed with family and friends around the table. Our Grain Free Tortilla Chips come in all different flavors, shapes and sizes! Our five-ounce tortilla chips are large format, light and crispy cantina-style tortilla chips, while our four-ounce tortilla chips are smaller, thicker triangles full of seasoning: • Sea Salt (5oz) • Lime (5oz) • No Salt (5oz) • Nacho (5oz) • Fuego (4oz) • Ranch (4oz) • Sal y Limón (4oz) • Nacho (4oz)

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our Beginnings. When our founder, Steven, and his wife, Sara Jade, became parents, they placed a newfound value on living a more natural, sustainable lifestyle. In Sara Jade’s search for clean personal care products, she became frustrated by confusing natural claims and long, complicated ingredient lists, and learned that only products with an organic certification can be trusted to be pure, less processed, and more effective than commonly available alternatives. This inspired them to create their own products, and Sky Organics was born. Simple, Botanically-Based Solutions. Our products are thoughtfully curated to complement and enhance your clean beauty routine, and are formulated with as few ingredients as possible. We only include ingredients that we know will effectively deliver desired benefits, and we offer many single-ingredient products because that is often all that is truly needed to effectively care for skin, hair, lashes, or eyebrows. Integrity and Transparency. Because organic is known to be the cleanest form of natural and is clearly defined and certified, we seek out organic ingredients whenever available. We know for certain that our ingredients are sustainably grown, harvested without chemicals or synthetic fillers, and maintain their natural integrity and potency. When we do occasionally use a non-organic ingredient, it’s always a thoughtful choice that weighs the ingredient’s beauty benefit versus its organic availability, and we clearly communicate this on our product labels. Created for All. It's important to us that clean, natural, organic solutions are available to and affordable for as many people as possible, regardless of who they are, what they look like, or where they live. With this in mind, we offer self care essentials for every skin type and hair type, with a wide variety of beauty benefits and uses. Join Our Journey. We invite you to redefine your everyday approach to beauty and embrace a more hopeful world with Sky Organics.

Removing the top layer of dead skin and stimulating the circulation of blood feeding the skin are essential for maintaining youthful, glowing and supple skin. Skin Brushing has been used throughout the world for centuries, and is making its way back into popularity. Dry skin brushing is one of the best ways to cleanse the skin without removing the protective mantle of acid and oils. It gently and effectively removes the top layer of dead skin cells with its build-up of dirt and acid, and deeply cleanses the pores. Skin brushing is one of the most powerful ways to cleanse the lymphatic system. Waste material is carried away from the cells by the blood and the lymph. Skin brushing stimulates the release of this material from the cells near the surface of the body. Eventually, most of the toxins along with their carrier cells, primarily lymphocytes, find their way to the colon for elimination. Skin brushing is also used by beauty salons as part of a program for removing cellulite. Skin brushing is most effective with an all-natural vegetable fiber brush, such as the Tampico Skin Brush. Make sure the brush isn t made of synthetic fiber since this can irritate the skin. A long handle is also helpful for reaching the back and entire body.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: GOODNESS IS OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLE. We choose what's best for our customers, our farmers, our employees and our planet. It's a tall order, but we wouldn't have it any other way. We're not in the business of making shareholders happy. In fact, we don't have shareholders. We're in the business of cooking delicious, organic vegetarian meals for everyone. We were organic before it was a national certification. So when the U.S. Department of Agriculture decided to create standards for organic, they looked to us for guidance. Together with other industry leaders, we helped pioneer the organic food industry and, more importantly, we helped make organic food available to more people. All of our dishes are non-GMO and we're a proud supporter of GMO labeling initiatives. Because we believe that people have a right to know what they put in their bodies. We were also the first to market with non-BPA-lined cans, and we're happy to see many other food companies following our lead.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Annie’s Cheddar Mac (as we call it!) is our answer to all those chemically orange colored cheeses out there. We’ve taken our original Shells & White Cheddar and added a little color to it, naturally! Our totally natural cheese is colored with a plant extract called annatto. Annatto has been used in tropical American cultures for generations to color foods such as butter, cheese and mustard. The annatto tree grows 20 to 30 feet in height and when its seeds are stirred in water, they produce orange annatto dye, also called achiote, to color foods. Annie’s Cheddar Macaroni and cheese is a great alternative for kids who need to have that “orange” cheese on their macaroni.

At Aura Cacia, we strive to find the best essential oils around the globe and have cultivated long-standing relationships with our growers and suppliers. Our aloe vera gel is not just certified fair trade but also designed to provide cooling, soothing comfort, making it the perfect after sun lotion for those hot summer days. Whether you're looking to soothe sunburn relief or simply maintain everyday skin vitality, this non-sticky aloe gel works like magic on your face and body. Hypoallergenic and unscented, its an ideal choice for those who value simplicity in beauty care without compromising effectiveness. Why is this 96% and not 100% pure aloe vera gel? Because 100 percent pure aloe gel would need to be refrigerated and would only last as long as fresh juice does. We use a few simple safe ingredient to preserve and stabilize our aloe. Any product claiming to be 100% aloe is misleading, unless it's literally a plant. Used as part of your daily routine or as critical after sun care, this vegan-friendly gel glides on smoothly without leaving any sticky residue behind. Convenience meets competence with Badger Organic Aloe Vera Gel ideal for both travelers and homebodies alike. Experience holistic skincare whether at home or away by incorporating our aloe vera lotion into your regimen today—it doubles as an excellent base under makeup or as a calming night cream replacement. Full Ingredient Lists: Organic Aloe , Xanthan Gum (from non-GMO corn), Water (and) Gluconic Acid (and) Sodium Benzoate (from cassia oil and natural fructose sources), Glyceryl Caprylate (from non-GMO plant material), Citric Acid (from non-GMO corn). = Certified Fair Trade. 96% of product.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Bare Bones Grass-Fed Lemon Ginger Bone Broth Instant Mix is perfect for school, the office, travel, backpacking, and beyond. Its aromatic, delicious flavor makes it the perfect sipping snack. These paleo and keto-friendly "rip sticks" pack the perfect serving of protein, collagen, and prebiotic fiber to fuel you on the go. Just rip, mix with hot water, and sip. Our bone broth warms the soul and nourishes the body, just like Grandma's homemade soup, but now in a convenient instant mix. Made with real bone broth, ground herbs, and spices, our bone broth is traditionally simmered low and slow for 14+ hours to extract protein, collagen, vitamins, and amino acids for the best flavor and nutrition. Enjoy this nutritional broth as a substitute for stock in your favorite recipes, as some added flavor to rice and soup, or as a sipping snack straight from a mug. No artificial flavorings, MSG, antibiotics, growth stimulants, or hormones. Gluten-free, soy-free, paleo, and keto-friendly. Created to inspire people to eat for health and longevity, Bare Bones Bone Broth was founded in 2014 by the health-conscious duo Ryan and Katherine Harvey. Our farm-to-table story comes from the essence of cooking hearty stock. We honor timeless, traditional cooking techniques to build flavor and nourishment, taking zero shortcuts and making no compromises. Bare Bones Broths are gelatinous when cold, fragrant when hot, loaded with nutrients, and, oh, so tasty.

My good buddy heft and I were hiking along the rugged shoreline of the Olympic Peninsula. On our first evening, as the final rays of sunshine dipped below the horizon, we breathed deep of the fresh ocean air and fixed our gazes upon the emerging stars. After several hours of philosophical banter on the meaning of life, my eyes settled on the most recognizable Beacon in the northern sky,the big Dipper. Suddenly my future flashed before my eyes. I would use elements of nature, which I so respect, to create a natural source of light. Handdippedbeeswax candles. And so big dipperwax works was born. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Boiron was founded in 1932 in Lyon, France, by twin brothers and pharmacists Jean and Henri Boiron. As the world leader in homeopathic medicines, Boiron is a $852 million public company with 3,700 employees and distribution in 59 countries. It is best known for Oscillococcinum, a top-selling flu medicine, and its Arnicare line of pain relievers. For more than 80 years, Boiron has been committed to funding scientific research and educating the public and health care professionals on homeopathic medicines. As a pharmaceutical company, Boiron maintains the highest standards in manufacturing, complying with U.S. Food and Drug Administration regulations, the Homeopathic Pharmacopoeia of the United States and drug Good Manufacturing Practices. The company partners with brokers, distributors and retail chains to make homeopathic medicines available to a wide variety of consumers and physicians. Boiron's staff of 120+ consists of pharmacists and lab technicians, accounting and IT personnel, marketing & public relations staff, national sales force, customer service, and order fulfillment and shipping professionals-many of whom have impressively long careers with the company. Our mission is to stimulate the evolution of health care by promoting homeopathy as a compassionate, ecological and comprehensive approach to medicine. At Boiron, we believe there's more than one way to feel better. Since 1932, the Boiron family has been committed to providing quality medicines. As world leader in homeopathy, our passion is your health. Our promise is your satisfaction. Watch our videos to find out more about Boiron USA.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Effortlessly craft extraordinary meals with Pacific Foods Low Sodium Organic Beef Broth. We slow-simmer humanely raised organic beef with onions, garlic and a touch of sea salt for a savory beef broth with 140mg of sodium per serving. Easier to prepare than beef bouillon, this low sodium broth is a delectably simple and nuanced canvas for your favorite dishes. Use it in any recipe that calls for low sodium beef broth, beef stock or water. It’s great as a soup base and for crafting delectable stews and ramen. It also elevates gravies, sauces and marinades, and it enhances the cooking of grains, protein and veggies. Each 32 oz recyclable carton contains approximately 4 servings of our gluten free and USDA Certified Organic broth. In addition to using it for cooking, you can enjoy this savory beef broth on its own as a simple yet flavorful beef soup. Customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a sandwich, salad or wrap. In addition to beef broth, Pacific Foods also offers chicken broth, turkey broth, vegetable broth and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Effortlessly craft extraordinary meals with Pacific Foods Low Sodium Organic Beef Broth. We slow-simmer humanely raised organic beef with onions, garlic and a touch of sea salt for a savory beef broth with 140mg of sodium per serving. Easier to prepare than beef bouillon, this low sodium broth is a delectably simple and nuanced canvas for your favorite dishes. Use it in any recipe that calls for low sodium beef broth, beef stock or water. It’s great as a soup base and for crafting delectable stews and ramen. It also elevates gravies, sauces and marinades, and it enhances the cooking of grains, protein and veggies. Each 32 oz recyclable carton contains approximately 4 servings of our gluten free and USDA Certified Organic broth. In addition to using it for cooking, you can enjoy this savory beef broth on its own as a simple yet flavorful beef soup. Customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a sandwich, salad or wrap. In addition to beef broth, Pacific Foods also offers chicken broth, turkey broth, vegetable broth and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Beef Bone Broth. We slow-simmer organic beef bones and vegetables for a savory bone broth that’s full of naturally occurring collagen. Sip a cup of warm beef bone broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. It’s great for refueling after workouts, beating the afternoon slump, or relaxing in the evening. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, season with cracked black pepper and fresh herbs. Our USDA-certified organic bone broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free of gluten, soy, wheat and yeast. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Beef Bone Broth contains 8 grams of protein, 1 gram of carbs, 0 grams of fat and 40 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. In addition to drinking it as a traditional sipping broth, you can use this bone broth in any recipe that calls for beef broth, beef stock or water. Try it as a stew or soup base, to enhance gravies and sauces, or to cook grains and veggies. In addition to beef bone broth, Pacific Foods also offers chicken bone broth.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Chicken Bone Broth With Sea Salt. We slow-simmer organic chicken bones, apple cider vinegar and a pinch of sea salt for a savory bone broth that’s full of naturally occurring collagen. Sip a cup of warm chicken bone broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. It's great for refueling after workouts, beating the afternoon slump, or relaxing in the evening. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, add a slice of lemon or some fresh rosemary. Our USDA-certified organic bone broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free ofgluten. It may also be suitable for paleo and keto diets. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Chicken Bone Broth contains 10 grams of protein, 1 gram of carbs and 50 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. In addition to drinking it as a traditional sipping broth, you can use this bone broth in any recipe that calls for chicken broth, chicken stock or water. Try it as a stew or soup base, to enhance gravies and sauces, or to cook grains and veggies. At Pacific Foods, we’re dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Unsalted Chicken Bone Broth. We slow-simmer organic chicken bones and apple cider vinegar for a savory bone broth that’s full of naturally occurring collagen without high sodium. Sip a cup of warm chicken bone broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. This organic chicken broth is great for refueling after workouts or beating the afternoon doldrums. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, add a slice of lemon, ginger or some fresh herbs. Our USDA-certified organic bone broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free ofgluten. It may also be suitable for paleo and keto diets. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Chicken Bone Broth contains 10 grams of protein, less than 1 gram of carbs and 50 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. In addition to drinking it as a traditional sipping broth, you can use this bone broth in any recipe that calls for chicken broth, chicken stock or water such as soups and casseroles. Try it as a soup base or to cook grains and veggies. Pacific Foods also offers chicken bone broth with sea salt and beef bone broth with sea salt. At Pacific Foods, we’re dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients. (*Not a sodium free food)

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Effortlessly craft extraordinary meals with Pacific Foods Organic Free-Range Chicken Broth. We slow-simmer organic free-range chicken with sea salt and just the right amount of seasonings for a savory organic chicken broth that’s rich and full of flavor. Easier to prepare than chicken bouillon, this broth is a delectably simple and nuanced canvas for your favorite dishes. Use it in any recipe that calls for 1 cup of chicken broth, chicken stock or water. It’s great as a soup base and for crafting delectable stews and ramen. It also elevates gravies, sauces and marinades, and it enhances the cooking of grains, potatoes and veggies. Each 8 oz recyclable carton contains a single serving of our gluten free and USDA Certified Organic broth. In addition to using it for cooking, you can enjoy this savory chicken broth on its own as a simple yet flavorful chicken soup. Customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a sandwich, salad or wrap. In addition to chicken broth, Pacific Foods also offers beef broth, turkey broth, vegetable broth and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

Roasting the beans enhances their naturally occurring antioxidant capacity and flavor to provide you with a cup of coffee that has a minimized level of performance-robbing mold-toxins.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: California Olive Ranch 100% Extra Virgin Olive Oil is crafted locally from our Californian farmers in California. This olive oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This accessible gourmet EVOO features well-rounded notes of a floral, buttery and fruity taste. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Coconut Amino make a great substitute for soy sauces. Coconut Amino have many benefits over soy-based sauces, including 14 times the amino acid content. Many soy sauces on the market are fermented by first soaking the soybeans in water and salt, and then adding specific cultures of molds, yeasts and bacteria to help catalyze the fermentation process. Coconut Amino is made from coconut tree sap, which comes right out of the tree so that vital, active and alive nutrients are blended with sun dried mineral-rich sea salt and aged, without the need for a fermentation booster or added water. Health Secrets of Coconut Amino: When the coconut tree is tapped, it produces a highly nutrient-rich "sap" that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This sap is very low glycemic (GI of only 35), is an abundant source of amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral PH The "Gran Moluccas Sea Salt" used in our Coconut Amino, garners its name from the exotic, tropical island of Mindanao, the 2nd largest island in the Philippines. A local culinary heritage in Mindanao, this unbleached, unrefined, naturally white sea salt, is fed only by the sun and the sea. It is hand-harvested by local salt producers working as their forefathers did, in their ancestral salt fields. Recipe Tips: Use Coconut Amino like soy sauce in dressings, marinades, sautés, and with sushi. Refrigerate after opening. "We love it so much we pour it over almost everything!" Coconut Amigos seasoning sauce is gluten free, contains 65% less sodium than soy sauce, is USDA organic, vegan and non-go.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt—the chocolate bar that delivers the perfect combination of rich dark chocolate and a delightful crunch! Packed with 51% cocoa and whole almonds, each bite offers a perfect balance of bold, robust dark chocolate and the satisfying crunch of almonds, all beautifully enhanced by a touch of sea salt. It’s the ultimate chocolate experience for anyone who loves the deep flavor of dark chocolate and the perfect contrast of salty and sweet! At Tony’s, we believe chocolate should be more than just a tasty indulgence—it should make a difference. That’s why we’re on a mission to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. Every bar of Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the 51% cocoa dark chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of almonds and a touch of sea salt to elevate the flavors. Whether you’re having a sweet snack, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of bold chocolate, crunchy nuts, and a hint of salt, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Dave's Killer Bread® Cinnamon Raisin Remix® Bagels are USDA organic cinnamon raisin bagels with killer taste and texture to mix up your morning routine. 12g protein and 11g whole grains per bagel. These sweet and cinnamony organic bagels have no high-fructose corn syrup, no artificial ingredients. You can trust Dave's Killer Bread® to deliver killer taste, texture and whole grain nutrition. The story of Dave’s Killer Bread® began at the Portland Farmers Market, when Dave Dahl and his nephew brought some loaves of Dave's bread to sell. For Dave, this marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Though he grew up in a family of bakers, his life took a different path. A path that landed him in prison for 15 years. Dave’s Killer Bread® believes everyone is capable of greatness. One in three of the company's employee partners at their Milwaukie, OR bakery has a criminal background—but your past doesn't define your future. As a proud Second Chance Employer, Dave’s Killer Bread® truly believes everyone deserves a second chance to become a Good Seed.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. It has a rougher surface, which helps the sauce stick to it. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Acini di Pepe (peppercorns) belong to the minute pasta family to be cooked in broth. This pasta shape was undoubtedly invented to stimulate the imagination of children who commonly eat this pasta in baby food and vegetable soups. It is shaped like peppercorns and is fun and appealing. It is especially good for preparing clear soups such as broths or consommé, enhanced with croutons or vegetables cut in julienne strips. This pasta can be used in thick creamy or velvety soups. Available in 16.0 oz pack.

Penne Rigate are part of the short, diagonal cut, ridged pasta family and are one of the most well-known type of pasta, as well as being the most versatile in the kitchen. In Italian, the term "Penne" refers to the goose feather which was used historically to write with and was cut on a diagonal to achieve a really thin tip. The shape, obtained from a pasta tube, can be smooth or ridged, of varying length and has the typical diagonal cut of a quill. Penne are one of the few types of pasta for which there is an exact date when it was created. Indeed, in 1865, a pasta-maker from San Martino d'Albaro (Genoa), Giovanni Battista Capurro, requested and obtained a patent for a diagonal cutting machine. The patent was important because it meant the fresh pasta could be cut like a quill without crushing it and in different lengths from 3 to 5 centimetres (mezze "half" penne or penne). The document preserved in the Central Archive of the State of Rome reads: "Up until now, a diagonal cut could only be made by hand with a pair of scissors which, in addition to being slow and time-consuming, also resulted in an irregular cut which flattened the pasta". Penne Rigate are perfect for preparing oven-baked pasta or pasta dishes served with meat sauces made from pork or beef. This pasta is equally as good with vegetable based sauces and more in general, due to its versatility, for any recipe from the Mediterranean tradition, such as the classic condiment with tomato, basil, extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. A classic combination is with Arrabbiata sauce. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb.

Historically, official mention of the term "spaghetto" can be traced back to the first dictionary of the Italian language by Nicolò Tommaseo and Bernardo Bellini (1819). The word "spaghetto" was included as the "masculine singular diminutive of spago (thread)" and mention is made of "Minestra di Spaghetti" (spaghetti soup) which is pasta the size of a long, thin thread such as sopracapellini". An interesting fact: in 1957, the BBC aired the first documentary on the production of spaghetti and the day after, the television studios were inundated by phone calls from viewers asking for the name of the producers and distributors of spaghetti so they could buy some. Spaghetti is so versatile that it can be served with any condiment, from fish to meat, from vegetables to cheese, but is also excellent served just with extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. You won’t find a better way to get clean!

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience a rich, nourishing lather with Dr. Bronner’s Magic Bar Soap—crafted with Regenerative Organic Certified Oils and thoughtfully formulated for a full-body clean that’s gentle yet effective. Whether you're reaching for Peppermint’s iconic tingle, Lavender’s calming floral, or the fragrance-free Baby Unscented, every bar is made to cleanse without drying out your face, body, or hair. Gentle and Effective Organic Ingredients Dr. Bronner’s bar soaps are made with vegan ingredients—no chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, or synthetic fragrances. These plant-based formulas offer a clean you can trust, free from harsh chemicals and suitable for sensitive skin and all ages (though not tear-free, so keep it out of little eyes!). No Synthetic Dyes or Detergents Our Pure-Castile Bar Soaps contain no synthetic dyes, detergents, or foaming agents. Just creamy, effective suds from organic coconut, palm, olive, and hemp oils that rinse clean while leaving skin soft, smooth, and nourished. Eco-Friendly Packaging Every bar is wrapped in post-consumer recycled paper, helping reduce waste and support global recycling efforts. This sustainable packaging choice diverts paper from landfills and speaks to our commitment to the planet. Regenerative Organic Certified We source our ingredients from fairly paid farmers who practice regenerative organic agriculture, including intercropping, composting, and reforestation. Every bar supports ecosystems, ethical supply chains, and the future of our soil. Elevate Your Clean with Dr. Bronner’s – The Original All-One Magic Bar Soap and More!

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Egyptian Magic Skin Cream – Multi-Purpose Moisturizer Made with Five Simple Ingredients Simplify your skincare routine with Egyptian Magic Skin Cream, a multi-purpose moisturizer crafted with just five carefully selected ingredients: honey, royal jelly, beeswax, olive oil, and bee propolis. It absorbs smoothly and helps improve the feel of dry areas without leaving skin feeling greasy. Whether used as part of your morning routine or before bedtime, Egyptian Magic Skin Cream provides lasting hydration for the face, hands, elbows, knees, lips, and body. Keep one at home or on the go for an easy, all-in-one moisturizing solution whenever your skin needs extra care.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Frankincense HydroSoul is an outstanding facial tonic for firming and toning wrinkles and fine lines, offering an instant "lift" to sagging facial muscles while also supplying the senses with a soothing and ethereal aroma: slightly sweet and peppery with undertones of resinous woods & truly the fragrance of the ancients. Frankincense has been used for thousands of years, and has been considered sacred to all cultures that encountered it. It's been found in beauty balms in the tombs of Ancient Egyptian Pharaohs, burned as incense in innumerable temples and churches to sanctify the space and summon Divine presence, and used as a tool in meditation, prayer and purification rituals. In the ancient world, pathways were forged in the desert to circulate this sacred plant through the spice trade. At that time, it was worth more than its weight in gold. It is protective, purifying, and fortifying for all skin and spirits. Distilled from the dried sap tears of the desert tree Boswellia Carterii, Frankincense is a powerful skin ally, like many desert plants are. Frankincense has an amazing ability to deeply beautify, hydrate, and rejuvenating the skin. This sacred water is a must in every collection. Our frankincense resin comes to us from the hills of Northern Somalia (Somaliland), and the resin is distilled in the US. Ingredients: Frankincense (Boswellia carterii) Hydrosol* *ORGANIC How to use: Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol & press onto skin. Facial tonic hydrosols can be used throughout the day to tone, hydrate & refresh. As a gentle morning cleanser, simply saturate skin & pat dry with a clean cloth. For optimal hydration & moisture, combine with one of our oil serums and/or moisturizers. Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol. In palms of hands, mix dime-sized amount of oil serum and/or a finger-full of moisturizer with 5-10 more sprays of hydrosol. Gently press mixture onto skin. Finishing with a misting of hydrosol.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Pomegranate Vitality Serum is an extraordinary combination of fruit, seed and berry oils known for their affinity with the skin's natural balance of oil and water (hydro-lipid layer) & their revitalizing effect on skin. This unscented (other than the natural aroma of essential fatty acids), nutrient-rich therapeutic treatment adds powerful antioxidant benefits to skin, with a high polyphenol and conjugated fatty acid content. It offers a holistic solution for blemished, congested, mature, aging, dry, dehydrated or irritated skin. Pomegranate Vitality Serum has exceptional moisturizing properties. Its visible effect on mature, dry, cracked & irritated skin is truly remarkable. Daily use increases vitality, elasticity, and suppleness while providing an elegant and silky feeling. Our pomegranate serum with sea buckthorn oil boosts vitality of the skin, evens skin tone, scavenges free radicals, helps relieve excessive redness, and helps minimize the appearance of fine lines & imperfections. The addition of supercritical sea buckthorn oil adds a nourishing & revitalizing action. Studies of sea buckthorn oil have suggested that the properties present in the berry extract may be due in part to its high content of punicic acid, essential fatty acids, carotenes, tocopherols and phytosterols - elements which are all important in the maintenance of a healthy skin. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our Rosehip Balancing Serum is beneficial for all types of skin. It is especially effective when combined with our facial tonic hydrosols, bringing vitality & suppleness to dry, oily, combination & sun-damaged skin. Our remarkable, certified organic rosehip seed oil comes from the Chilean Andes. Known as rosa rubiginosa or rosa mosqueta, this silky oil of the rose hip seed has been used for centuries by the indigenous people of the Chilean Andes to treat burned, sun-damaged or scarred skin. Rosehip seed oil is rich in the naturally occurring pro-vitamin A and vitamin C. It has considerable amounts of polyunsaturated essential fatty acids (EFA) containing 80% gamma linolenic acid and linoleic acid. As a result it significantly regenerates and strengthens cell membranes aiding in the prevention of early signs of aging. With daily use, Rosehip Treatment Facial Serum works to minimize and soften the appearance of scars, and smooth fine lines and wrinkles. It also soothes dry, sunburned and sun-damaged skin. This Serum helps to balance excessively oily or dry skin, minimize the appearance of large pores, and purify impure skin prone to pimples. Used on a consistent basis, your skin will look smoother, fresher and more supple. Precious essential oils of rose geranium, sandalwood, rose otto & carrot seed are added to enhance the action of the rosehip seed oil. Their tiny molecular size and lipophilic (oil-loving) tendency make them ideal for curative skin treatments. Ingredients: Rosehip Seed (Rosa canina) Fruit Oil*, Jojoba (Simmondsia chinensis) Seed Oil*, Rose Geranium (Pelargonium graveolens) Oil*, Carrot (Daucus carota) Seed Essential Oil*, Hawaiian Sandalwood (Santalum paniculatum) Wood Oil*, Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Flower Oil*, Rose Otto (Rosa damascena) Flower Oil*, Vitamin E (Tocopherol) *ORGANIC How to use: Use oil serum & HydroSoul together. Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol. In palms of hands, mix dime-sized amount of oil serum with 5-10 more sprays of hydrosol. Gently press mixture onto skin evenly distributing between cheeks, forehead & chin. Finish with a misting of hydrosol. For drier skin, follow with one of our occlusive moisturizers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Calm, clear hydration — without clogging pores. Evre Super Nice Mānuka Honey & Vitamin E Face Moisturizer is a lightweight, non-comedogenic daily moisturizer specially formulated to soothe, balance, and deeply hydrate teen and sensitive skin. This fast-absorbing formula locks in moisture as the final step in your routine while supporting a healthy skin barrier — without triggering breakouts or irritation. Key Benefits & Features Formulated for Teen Skin — Hormone-friendly and gentle on young, sensitive, breakout-prone, or easily irritated skin. Free from harsh actives and endocrine disruptors that can interfere with developing bodies. Suitable for all skin types. 10+ UMF Mānuka Honey + Vitamin E — Powered by premium Mānuka honey to naturally soothe and protect, plus Vitamin E to strengthen and support the skin barrier. Deep Hydration That Feels Light — A nourishing blend of Jojoba, Avocado, and Rosehip oils delivers lasting moisture while absorbing quickly for a non-greasy, fresh finish. Non-Comedogenic & Pore-Friendly — Hydrates deeply without blocking pores or causing breakouts. Ideal for daily morning and night use on combination, acne-prone, or sensitive teen skin. Clean & Conscious Formula — Made with all-natural ingredients. Certified cruelty-free and palm-free. Free from parabens, phthalates, PEGs, and known hormone disruptors. Naturally fragranced with a subtle, fresh honey scent. Give Back With Every Purchase — A percentage of sales supports youth mental health initiatives in your community. Made in the USA with Sustainable Packaging — Proudly formulated and manufactured in the United States. Packaged in a bottle made with 30% post-consumer recycled (PCR) plastic. Net Wt. 3.4 fl oz (100 ml). How to Use Apply a small amount to clean face and neck morning and evening after cleansing. Use as the final step in your skincare routine to lock in hydration. Full Ingredients Water, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Brassica Alcohol, Glycerin, Stearic Acid, Glyceryl Stearate, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Xanthan Gum, Behenyl Alcohol, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Mel, Glyceryl Stearate Citrate, Sodium Olivoyl Glutamate, Benzyl Alcohol, Sodium Benzoate, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Glyceryl Oleate, Citric Acid, Tocopheryl Acetate, Dehydroacetic Acid, *Parfum (*natural honey scent).

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: We believe what goes on your body is as important as what goes in it. That's why our beauty and body care standards go beyond typical "clean beauty" claims. We ban 240+ ingredients commonly used in beauty and body products, including parabens, phthalates, formaldehyde donors, oxybenzone, PFAS and EDTA. Our experts review the latest research on beauty and body care ingredients for many factors including possible impacts on the environment and human health. Organic claims on our body care products are required to be backed up by third-party certification. Products labeled "organic" are required to contain at least 95% organic ingredients and be certified to the USDA National Organic Standards.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Made from only Italian olives, the Lucini Italia Premium Select Extra Virgin Olive Oil is the definition of a robust Italian extra virgin olive oil. The olives are grown on hillside estates in Italy, where many of the olive trees date back 100 years. Our Premium Select Extra Virgin Olive Oil boasts a naturally low acidity and balance. Harvested at fruit’s peak flavor intensity for a green and full flavor profile with a peppery finish that is distinctly Italian. You’ll taste hints of almond with a peppery finish in this gourmet EVOO. These flavor profiles pair well with any dish, which is why we recommend it for your everyday cooking application – marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether for a sweet or savory dish, and using olive oil in your daily diet has shown to promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. Prepared in small batches using 100% natural ingredients, Lucini Italia products offer both exceptional taste and culinary perfection. We work with small regional farmers and celebrated chefs in Italy, to provide you with an unmatched selection of ingredients, gourmet recipes, quality, assurance, and convenience.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: We believe what goes on your body is as important as what goes in it. That's why our beauty and body care standards go beyond typical "clean beauty" claims. We ban 240+ ingredients commonly used in beauty and body products, including parabens, phthalates, formaldehyde donors, oxybenzone, PFAS and EDTA. Our experts review the latest research on beauty and body care ingredients for many factors including possible impacts on the environment and human health. Organic claims on our body care products are required to be backed up by third-party certification. Products labeled "organic" are required to contain at least 95% organic ingredients and be certified to the USDA National Organic Standards.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: FLO Bamboo Panty Liners are the perfect plant-powered protection for daily discharge or light flows. Each liner is made with silky-soft organic bamboo that's not just comfortable and breathable, but Oeko-Tex certified too. Oeko-Tex means that the bamboo is organic and tested by independent labs to ensure it's free from harmful substances - zero irritation here! FLO panty liners for women / menstruators are hypoallergenic and don't contain any harsh chemicals, synthetic fibres, chlorine or dyes - perfect for FLO Babes with sensitive skin. Each of the 24 bamboo thong panty liners are ultra-thin and individually wrapped in compostable, plant-based wrappers, perfect for absorbing your flow on-the-go. We're a business founded by two women-of-colour for people who menstruate, that's why every pack back gives back with 5% of profits going to people + planet. Vegan, cruelty-free, Carbon Neutral and BCorp Certified. We've got your back (and your front) with shamelessly natural care for life's messiest moments.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: FLO Bamboo Day + Night Pads are award-winning, plant-powered protection for your period with maximum absorption to keep you dry without any leaks. Each super-comfy pad is made with silky-soft organic bamboo that's not just comfortable and breathable, but Oeko-Tex certified too. Oeko-Tex means that the bamboo is organic and tested by independent labs to ensure it's free from harmful substances - zero irritation here! FLO organic sanitary pads are hypoallergenic and don't contain any harsh chemicals, synthetic fibres, chlorine or dyes - perfect for FLO Babes with sensitive skin. Each of the 10 Day + 5 Night Pads are ultra-thin and individually wrapped in compostable, plant-based wrappers, perfect for absorbing heavy flow on-the-go. We're a business founded by two women-of-colour for people who menstruate, that's why every pack back gives back with 5% of profits going to people + planet. Vegan, cruelty-free, Carbon Neutral and BCorp Certified. We've got your back (and your front) with shamelessly natural care for life's messiest moments.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Super Absorbent: Our Liners, Pads, and Tampons are all super absorbent, leak-proof protection for your flow. Super Soft: Our pads + Liners use silky bamboo viscose made with organic bamboo. Flo Tampons are made with cloud-soft organic cotton. Period pants made with sustainably sourced cotton. Sensitive Skin Friendly: Designed with delicate skin in mind and made without chlorine bleach, artificial dyes, or fragrances. Tampons made without synthetic fibres. No irritation. No drama. Low Impact Packaging: All our products come in recyclable paper boxes, and our pads, liners, and tampons are wrapped in compostable, plant-based, biofilm. Susan & Tara met on their first day of their master's program at LSE and fell into an instant best friendship. The idea for the business started on a classic BFF bathroom trip between lectures. Susan wanted to start a Fempire to take on the toxic patriarchy bros, while Tara couldn't find organic tampons anywhere in the UK. Susan was like, 'Organic tampons? Why do you even need those? A long chat about the impact of synthetic fibers and harsh chemicals, many late nights, and a master's dissertation later, and Here We Flo was born. We are a proudly female owned and led, B-CORP business on a mission to empower people with periods to feel crazy confident even when it’s messy. At Here We Flo, we treat period care as personal care, not sanitary hygiene. Because your vagina deserves better. We create “better for you” accessible upgrades for period, pee, and pleasure that are better for vaginas + vulvas. Using materials that you can trust to work. No drama. No bad vibes. Just premium vulva experiences. Crazy confidence is all about how you feel inside. So we fight shame and stigma around periods, pee, and pleasure with a funny, feminist, + fierce personality and empower our community with actually useful information. We’re also committed to giving 5% of profits back to people + planet. Welcome to the Fempire, bestie.

We ban 240+ ingredients commonly used in beauty and body products, including parabens, phthalates, formaldehyde donors, oxybenzone, PFAS and EDTA. Products labeled "organic" are required to contain at least 95% organic ingredients and be certified to the USDA National Organic Standards.

We ban 240+ ingredients commonly used in beauty and body products, including parabens, phthalates, formaldehyde donors, oxybenzone, PFAS and EDTA. Our experts review the latest research on beauty and body care ingredients for many factors including possible impacts on the environment and human health. Organic claims on our body care products are required to be backed up by third-party certification. Products labeled "organic" are required to contain at least 95% organic ingredients and be certified to the USDA National Organic Standards.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Frankies Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil is renowned for its exceptional quality and rich flavor. Made from hand-picked Nocellara del Belice olives grown in the sun-drenched groves of Selinunte, Sicily, this organic olive oil offers a flavor profile that is fruity, nutty, deep, and bright. Cold-pressed immediately after harvest, it preserves the natural antioxidants and nutrients of the olives, with no additives, chemicals, or preservatives. The result is a flavorful, robust oil with a smooth, peppery finish that enhances every dish, from roasted vegetables and grilled meats to soups, salads, and even vanilla ice cream. With its high smoke point and balanced taste, Frankies Extra Virgin Olive Oil is a versatile pantry staple perfect for cooking, baking, dipping, or drizzling. Crafted using time-honored methods and trusted by home cooks and chefs alike, this Frankies Extra Virgin Olive Oil represents generations of Mediterranean tradition and authenticity. Ideal for those seeking premium-quality olive oil for everyday use.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: GIOVANNI's 2chic Ultra-Moist Conditioner is powered by our Dual Moisture Complex of Avocado and Olive Oil that helps to add significant moisture, strength and shine for healthier and more lustrous locks that you can style with confidence. This ultra moisturizing Conditioner silkens coarse hair with softness and shine. Look in the Ingredients section for a listing of *USDA certified organic ingredients.GIOVANNI was the first full-range, salon-inspired hair-care brand in natural product stores, and today is the #1 selling Hair Care line in the United States Natural Products Industry. But before there was a brand, there was a pioneer. Arthur Guidotti had a vision and a love for all things hair. He began developing his passion as a hairstylist in Hollywood and Beverly Hills. He worked for a time with hairstylist icon Gene Shacove and was good friends with “the father of hair color,” Al Lapin . By the 1960s, Arthur was maturing his talents and decided to open his own salon, called On Sunset. The salon was a bustling site, on the famous Sunset Strip, and a hit with many Hollywood celebrities, including Lucille Ball . Since 1979 the GIOVANNI Rule of Balance has been our commitment to make each product as pure and as natural as possible without sacrificing exceptional product performance. GIOVANNI is committed to creating only the highest-performance formulations, wrapped in aesthetically beautiful packaging and marketed with extraordinary visuals and graphics.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: California Olive Ranch’s globally inspired, Destination Series is a celebration of high quality high-quality extra virgin olive oil produced around the world. The olives are proudly grown and harvested by our partner growers in Argentina, Chile, Portugal, and our California farmers, and are expertly blended in California to create the ideal taste profile. This Olive Oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This gourmet EVOO features well-rounded tasty notes of fresh herbs, fruit and green grass. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.

This Olive Oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This gourmet EVOO features well-rounded tasty notes of fresh herbs, fruit and green grass. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.
