whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A truly unscented tea light that sets a calm, steady glow without soot, smoke, or a scent that fights your food, your essential oils, or a quiet moment. If you have been let down by candles that promise neutral and still smell like chemicals, these are different. The reason is the wax. Many households switched to palm wax after looking for a cleaner-burning alternative to paraffin and soy. GoodLight is made from 100% non-GMO palm wax, not petroleum-derived paraffin, so it burns clean with no soot and no smoke. There is no added fragrance, no phthalates, and no chemicals, just a plain, honest flame. The burn matters as much as the wax. A filament-free cotton wick stays lit, giving a steady, even burn that relights to the bottom of the cup with no tunneling and no waste. Each candle burns up to 4+ clean hours, and for the longest, most even burn, use one continuous cycle rather than relighting several times. These long lasting tea lights candles hold their own on a dinner table or under a wax warmer. Because they are unscented, these palm-wax tea lights fit standard essential-oil diffusers and wax and tart warmers without ever competing with your oils. They sit in standard tea-light holders for everyday indoor home ambiance, and their neutral flame suits Shabbat, prayer, and altar tables. Crafters reach for them as a gentle heat source for wax-seal stamping. As a clean-burning cross-shopper pick for soy tealight candles buyers, they deliver the neutral burn without the soy. This 400 count case is the bulk pack: enough white tea lights for weddings, hosting, and fragrance-free dinner settings, so you are never caught short. Every cup is recyclable aluminum, every box is recyclable paperboard printed with vegetable-based inks, and every purchase supports the sustainable palm oil movement. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Protein packed Skyr (“skeer”) has been a provision of Icelanders for nearly 1,000 years. Our Skyr was developed with Iceland’s oldest farmer-owned dairy. It is the only Skyr available in the US that contains Icelandic Heirloom Skyr Cultures that Icelanders have been enjoying for centuries. Our heirloom cultures help make our Skyr thick, creamy and delicious. On rare occasions, Viking traders would score a few coconuts. Taste this creamy Nordic/tropic fusion, and you’ll know how lucky they felt.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Protein packed Skyr (“skeer”) has been a provision of Icelanders since the days of the Vikings, and it’s still enjoyed by Icelanders of all ages to this day. Icelandic Provisions uses the same heirloom skyr cultures that Icelanders have passed down for generations. Fresh whole milk from family farms gives Krímí Skyr a rich, creamy texture. We add cold brew from Te and Kaffi, a family-owned coffee roastery in Iceland. Give your taste buds a wake-up call. Whether it’s your breakfast go-to or an afternoon treat, Krímí Skyr is a richer, creamier way to bring a little joy to your everyday.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: THE HEADBAND | This twist headband for men is a top seller and for good reason. For starters, it's made from ridiculously soft, sweat-wicking and breathable organic cotton. A warning: once you go organic, you'll never be able to wear a synthetic (read: plastic) headband again. Second, it works. We designed the sweatband with a twist that sits at the nape of the neck, keeping the headband from slipping during even the sweatiest workout. This design, coupled with the sweat-wicking organic cotton, means no more headband slipping during your workouts. Third, it's versatile. Choose to wear the headband thin like a tennis headband, scrunched for a rocker-headband or opened wide for a full bandana head covering, Last but not least, it's ethically made. Read more about this last point in the "About KOOSHOO" section below. MATERIALS | The body of this twist headwrap is made from 93% organic cotton and 7% spandex. ABOUT KOOSHOO | KOOSHOO is an eco-friendly clothing and accessories brand created by husband and wife yoga teachers to help others feel good (KOOSHOO literally means "feeling good"). We make organic headbands, the world's ONLY plastic-free hairties, stylish shawls and baby plants that grow with a child. We always use the finest organic and natural materials, ethically manufacture in certified facilities, dye using low-impact azo-free dyes and package in 100% recycled and/or biodegradable packaging. We're a small business run by real people that care deeply about our customers, suppliers and the environment. We stand 100% behind our products (full refunds and/or exchanges if not stoked) and every time a sale is made, the team does a happy dance in honor of the customer.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Lumineux is the first truly ethical oral care company to emerge on the market in close to a century. Founded on decades of international research conducted by two world-renowned dentists, our products have a back-to-basics approach that use naturally occurring ingredients like Dead Sea salt, aloe vera juice and potent essential oils to handle the source of bad breath, decay and disease without cumulative side-effects, and unnecessary additives. Lumineux is the first oral care product to protect the oral micro biome and neutralize the toxins of bad bacteria, rather than indiscriminately killing bacteria. The result is a clean, non-toxic, and proven effective line of solutions that are backed by clinical and in-the-field studies that are truly head and shoulders above what’s available to consumers. Dr. Kourosh Maddahi, Lumineux’s Founder and CEO, puts it perfectly, saying, “You shouldn’t have to choose between a product that’s good for you, and a product that actually works.” Lumineux remains the only oral care line to carry the Made Safe certification, as well as Non- Toxic certification for all its products from the LEMI Lab in France, and head-to-head clinical studies against every leading brand from the University of Irvine, California.

Quatrefolic is the 4th generation development in folate delivery. With certain inherited errors in metabolism and under a variety of physiologic stresses, the transformation of folic acid into the active form of folate either does not properly take place or is inadequate. Unlike folic acid, 5-MTHF can cross the blood-brain barrier. HEALTH CLAIM: Healthful diets with adequate folic acid may reduce a woman's risk of having a child with certain brain or spinal cord defects.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A deeply hydrating treatment packed with 3 forms of vitamin C, potent antioxidants & adaptogens. With 19 cutting-edge actives, this synergistic formula brings dramatically brighter, healthier, smoother looking skin in just one jar! Triple C - 3 bioavailable forms of vitamin C, each with distinct biological processes, join forces to rejuvenate and protect the skin from exposure to daily stressors. Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate, Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate & Ascorbyl Glucoside, all incredibly bioavailable & effective forms of vitamin C, work to brighten the skin and reduce the appearance of discoloration, while lessening the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Reishi - Known as the "mushroom of immortality" in Chinese medicine, reishi is a powerful adaptogen that is packed with antioxidants and hydrating elements. Sodium PCA – A naturally occurring humectant, Sodium PCA helps bind moisture to the skin, dramatically improving skin hydration. Cloudberry - A revered Nordic berry notorious for its ability to grow in the harshest of conditions, Cloudberry is packed with rejuvenating antioxidants such as vitamin C & beta carotene that help even the complexion and brighten! Turmeric extract - A powerhouse antioxidant great for acne-prone skin, turmeric extract helps lighten the appearance of skin discoloration and provide antioxidant protection. Turmeric extract gives the benefits of the revered ancient herb, without the yellow staining effect of standard turmeric. Chaga - A natural adaptogen packed with powerful antioxidants including superoxide dismutase and zinc. Works to rejuvenate and protect the skin from daily stressors and exposure to pollutants. Shea Butter - Used in Africa for centuries for its moisturizing & soothing properties, shea butter is a rich source of the powerful antioxidants vitamin A & E, crucial fatty acids and cinnamic acid. Ceramide - Forms a thin lipid barrier that holds in moisture, while protecting & nourishing the skin.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Conquer your day with MegaFood Balanced B Complex; a Vitamin B complex for women and men, formulated with all eight types of B Vitamins, including Biotin and bioavailable B12 methylcobalamin and Methyl folate. This balanced ratio of B Complex vitamins delivered with nourishing real foods helps convert food into cellular energy your body can put to use. Beyond their cellular energy benefits, B Vitamins, like B1 and B12, support whole body health, including nervous system health and cardiovascular function. The combination of Vitamin B12 with Folate and Vitamin B6 is also known to support normal red blood cell formation and the production of neurotransmitters needed for brain health. B6 Vitamins in this Vitamin B Complex also support cognitive health.* Real food and added nutrients make MegaFood Balanced B Complex unique to many other B Complex vitamins. In this supplement, we’ve added brown rice, kale, and broccoli that your body can easily recognize.* Adults take one tablet daily with a beverage. For your convenience, this supplement may be taken any time of day, even on an empty stomach. Offering 50mcg per serving of B12 Vitamins, this supplement could be a good option for vegetarians and vegans who may not consume enough B12 from their diets alone.* MegaFood Balanced B Complex is vegan, gluten-free, non-GMO, Kosher, and third party tested for over 150 chemical substances. For added peace of mind, this B Complex vitamin supplement is made without milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish, and sesame.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: What's the secret to making exceptional foods? Using exceptional ingredients! Morton Gothelf, the founder of Morton & Bassett Spices, had always been a great cook and always seemed to be entertaining friends. He was passionate about finding just the right ingredients to create the perfect combination of flavors. In searching for superior ingredients, he found that the best quality spices were difficult to obtain in a typical grocery or gourmet store. Morton began to find sources for the best spices and then started Morton & Bassett Spices in 1986, hoping to fill this niche. The combination of great ingredients, good value and clear bottles that showcased the product was a hit. Since 1986 the business has grown quickly thanks to the growing numbers of loyal Morton & Bassett customers. Once a good cook tries Morton & Bassett they inevitably become loyal fans. Today there are over 100 world class spices in the product line and more flavors are in the works.

Morton began to find sources for the best spices and then started Morton & Bassett Spices in 1986, hoping to fill this niche. The combination of great ingredients, good value and clear bottles that showcased the product was a hit. Since 1986 the business has grown quickly thanks to the growing numbers of loyal Morton & Bassett customers. Once a good cook tries Morton & Bassett they inevitably become loyal fans. Today there are over 100 world class spices in the product line and more flavors are in the works.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience the gentle revolution in hair color with Naturcolor’s innovative botanical-based formula. Unlike conventional dyes that strip hair with harsh chemicals and deposit monotone dye, our unique approach uses just enough chemistry to enable Naturcolor’s fine Italian pigments to adhere to each strand, preserving hair's natural variation while effectively covering gray. The result? Rich, multi-dimensional color that looks authentically yours with significantly less risk of irritation or damage. Our nourishing botanical blend actually improves shine, strength, and overall health with every application. Naturcolor fits easily into your life with a refreshingly pleasant experience that minimizes harsh odors and mess. What was once a necessary chore becomes a moment of intentional self-care, leaving you with healthy, vibrant hair that helps you feel ready for whatever comes your way. With Naturcolor, you never need to choose between beautiful, lustrous locks and your personal well-being. Crafted in small batches in California since 1992, Naturcolor is not just for women. Thousands of men have discreetly colored their hair with it at home. And the gentler formula is great for coloring facial hair without irritation or staining. Naturcolor comes in 31 colors that can be blended to create your own unique shade. A complete application takes less than an hour and one box can be used for multiple root touch-ups. Note: Final results will vary based on original hair color. Hair that is much lighter than your selected Naturcolor shade will appear lighter after coloring, while hair closer to the Naturcolor shade will take on a deeper, more intense color. This variability also applies to gray hair, which will take color differently than darker strands, contributing to the dimensional results that make Naturcolor look natural and never “dyed”.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A gentle, creamy body wash infused with Goat's Milk, Shea Butter, Chai, and Rose Extracts, that cleanses while keeping skin feeling hydrated and soft to reveal a radiant look. This Body cleanser lathers and diffuses elegant and floral notes for a soothing ambiance. Heritage: Ancient images of roses on Egyptian and Abyssinian tomb walls date back to 500 BC. Inspired by the softening rose and milk baths of Cleopatra, this modern interpretation highlights these well-documented skincare additives. Chai, the word for tea in Swahili, is integral to the cultural and social fabric of many civilizations. Rich in antioxidants, Chai helps nourish the skin to maintain a more youthful looking appearance. Usage instructions: Apply this body and face wash to a washcloth or hands and work into a lather to cleanse the entire body. Rinse completely. Humble Beginnings: Nubian Heritage has been guided by the legacy of ancient Nubia, the world's first melting pot. Ancient Nubia was once a center of cultural trade - a place where goods, ideas, and customs from across Africa, Asia, the Middle East and the Mediterranean came together, influenced each other, and then spread across the ancient world. That is our inspiration.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Toning & Uplifting Made with: Rosehip Seed Oil Certified B Corporation Ethically Traded Ingredients Sustainably Produced No Animal TestingA gentle, nutrient-rich body wash enriched with Buriti Oil hydrates and calms the skin. Fragrant Patchouli Oil works to uplift and soothe the senses while Shea Butter and Rosehip Seed Oil combine to cleanse the skin without drying. Leave skin soft and renewed.Humble BeginningsNubian Heritage is the brainchild of two New York street vendors. In 1992, fresh out of college and without jobs, Rich and Nyema embarked on a mission to produce luxurious natural products from traditional African recipes with fair trade ingredients. Today Nubian Heritage offers culturally authentic natural products inspired by global ancient healing philosophies. Although Nubian Heritage products are no longer made in bath tubs, little else has changed; the company still makes its products, still uses fair trade ingredients and still invests in community commerce.HeritageA time honored Asian beauty secret, Patchouli relaxes and soothes the senses while Buriti Oil, made from the fruit of Buriti Palm, known as the "tree of life", hydrates and rejuvenates skin's appearance. Emphasizing the ingredients' brightening properties, our package symbolizes happiness and is representative of Thailands' textile industry, which economically empowers countless communities and employs over one million individuals.Manufactured in the USA with ethically sourced ingredients around the world.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Elevate your home cooking with our Organic Mushroom Dashi, a rich, plant-based foundation inspired by the traditions of Japanese cuisine. Just as a Western chef reaches for a flavorful vegetable stock, Japanese cooks rely on dashi to create depth, balance, and savory complexity in countless dishes. Whether you're building a comforting bowl of miso soup, preparing a hearty hot pot, or adding umami richness to everyday recipes, this ready-to-use broth saves you hours of prep time while delivering authentic flavor. Simply shake well, pour, and bring restaurant-quality taste to your kitchen. Crafted with organic mushrooms and nourishing kelp, this vegan dashi delivers a deep, earthy umami character with layers of savory flavor that powder concentrates simply can't match. The combination creates a smooth, well-rounded broth that enhances everything from traditional Japanese dishes to modern plant-based cooking, making it an indispensable pantry staple for home chefs and culinary enthusiasts alike.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Elevate your home cooking with our traditional liquid Dashi, the essential foundation of authentic Japanese cuisine. Just as a Western chef reaches for chicken or vegetable stock, a Japanese kitchen relies on dashi. Whether you are deglazing a pan for a fusion stir-fry or preparing a traditional shabu-shabu, this ready-to-use base saves you hours of prep time without sacrificing quality. Simply shake well, pour, and watch as your kitchen transforms into a professional Japanese bistro. Crafted with a blend of premium katsuobushi (dried skipjack, bullet, and frigate tuna) and nourishing kelp, this broth delivers a complex, smoky umami depth that powder concentrates simply can’t match. Finishing with tamari soy sauce, we’ve ensured a richer, smoother savory profile that perfectly complements everything from classic miso soup to simmered stews and vibrant hot pots.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Nutiva Organic Liquid Coconut Oil is rich in MCTs, making it a nourishing and versatile great food for cooking, baking, and beauty. Unlike other oils on the market, Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil is never processed using hexane or other dangerous chemicals. At Nutiva, we start with organic, non-GMO Southeast Asian coconuts, sustainably harvested and immediately cold pressed to naturally extract the fresh, flavorful coconut oil. Next, Nutiva uses a USDA certified organic process to extract the fats from the virgin coconut oil that remain solid at room temperature, resulting in an oil that remains liquid, even at cooler temperatures. The neutral flavor makes it great for sautéing, baking, or enhancing your favorite recipes. It's ideal as a medium-heat cooking oil, a nutritious substitute in baking and is an excellent alternative to olive oil. It’s also a wholesome addition to vegetarian, vegan, raw, whole food, paleo-friendly, ketogenic, and gluten-free diets. The purity and nutrient density of Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil make it good for you both inside and out. Use the luscious, soothing oil as a natural skin moisturizer, eye make-up remover, deep conditioning hair treatment, or combine it with Nutiva Coconut Sugar and your favorite essential oil for an exfoliating, refreshing body scrub. Nutiva was founded in 1999 with a single purpose in mind - to Revolutionize the Way the World Eats. We produce organic, nutrient-dense foods that are good for you and good for the planet. Social and environmental responsibility is a core part of Nutiva’s culture and business. We are dedicated to sourcing organic products, obtaining fair trade certification, greening our facilities and operations, and funding tree planting at schools in our local community; we are constantly seeking ways to better protect our environment and ensure a better quality of life for employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: What's the secret to making exceptional foods? Using exceptional ingredients! Morton Gothelf, the founder of Morton & Bassett Spices, had always been a great cook and always seemed to be entertaining friends. He was passionate about finding just the right ingredients to create the perfect combination of flavors. In searching for superior ingredients, he found that the best quality spices were difficult to obtain in a typical grocery or gourmet store. Morton began to find sources for the best spices and then started Morton & Bassett Spices in 1986, hoping to fill this niche. The combination of great ingredients, good value and clear bottles that showcased the product was a hit. Since 1986 the business has grown quickly thanks to the growing numbers of loyal Morton & Bassett customers. Once a good cook tries Morton & Bassett they inevitably become loyal fans. Today there are over 100 world class spices in the product line and more flavors are in the works.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Dave’s Killer Bread® Limited Edition Pumpkin Spice Madness Bagels bring a bold, cozy autumn twist to your everyday breakfast routine. This isn’t your everyday pumpkin spice—it’s organic Pumpkin Spice Madness, turned up loud, bold, and wildly unapologetic. Infused with warm pumpkin spice flavor featuring organic cinnamon, brown sugar and pumpkin, and hearty whole grain nutrition, these soft, satisfying pumpkin spice bagels deliver a crave‑worthy balance of subtly sweet spice and signature Dave’s texture in every bite. 13g whole grains,10g protein, and 4g fiber per bagel. Our organic pumpkin spice bagels help keep you fueled and satisfied all morning long. Made with organic ingredients and pumpkin spice, these pumpkin spice bagels offer feel‑good nutrition without sacrificing flavor. USDA organic and Non‑GMO Project Verified, Pumpkin Spice Madness Bagels are crafted with the quality you expect from Dave’s Killer Bread®—no bleached flour, no high fructose corn syrup, and no artificial preservatives or artificial ingredients. Just clean, organic ingredients you can trust. The story of Dave’s Killer Bread® began at the Portland Farmers Market, when Dave Dahl and his nephew brought some loaves of Dave's bread to sell. For Dave, this marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Though he grew up in a family of bakers, his life took a different path. A path that landed him in prison for 15 years. Determined to prove his worth and make a positive impact, Dave worked tirelessly to bake breads that tasted unlike anything else on the market — packed with seeds and grains, made with only the very best organic and Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients. Dave’s Killer Bread® believes everyone is capable of greatness. One in three of the company's employee partners at their Milwaukie, OR bakery has a criminal background—but your past doesn't define your future. As a proud Second Chance Employer, Dave’s Killer Bread® truly believes everyone deserves a second chance to become a Good Seed.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: What's the secret to making exceptional foods? Using exceptional ingredients! Morton Gothelf, the founder of Morton & Bassett Spices, had always been a great cook and always seemed to be entertaining friends. He was passionate about finding just the right ingredients to create the perfect combination of flavors. In searching for superior ingredients, he found that the best quality spices were difficult to obtain in a typical grocery or gourmet store. Morton began to find sources for the best spices and then started Morton & Bassett Spices in 1986, hoping to fill this niche. The combination of great ingredients, good value and clear bottles that showcased the product was a hit. Since 1986 the business has grown quickly thanks to the growing numbers of loyal Morton & Bassett customers. Once a good cook tries Morton & Bassett they inevitably become loyal fans. Today there are over 100 world class spices in the product line and more flavors are in the works.

We ban 240+ ingredients commonly used in beauty and body products, including parabens, phthalates, formaldehyde donors, oxybenzone, PFAS and EDTA. Our experts review the latest research on beauty and body care ingredients for many factors including possible impacts on the environment and human health. Organic claims on our body care products are required to be backed up by third-party certification. Products labeled "organic" are required to contain at least 95% organic ingredients and be certified to the USDA National Organic Standards.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Butter Chicken and Rice Soup. This organic soup has tender organic chicken, chickpeas, potatoes, and brown rice. Ginger, turmeric and other seasonings round out the flavor of this soup, bringing a classic recipe to a whole new level of goodness. We slow-simmer organic free-range chicken with sea salt and seasonings for a savory organic chicken broth that's rich and full of flavor. Sip a cup of warm chicken broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. It's great for refueling after workouts, beating the afternoon slump, or relaxing in the evening. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, add a slice of lemon, ginger or some fresh herbs to your gluten free broth. Our USDA Certified Organic broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free of gluten and fat.(1) It may also be suitable for keto diets. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Broth contains less than 1 gram of carbs and 10 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: ★Partners Coffee: A fresh morning start★Our flagship espresso at our original Williamsburg shop and roastery. Bedford is comprised of two of our oldest sourcing relationships, the coffees from which merge together to create an incredibly delicious and complex experience. Look for ripe stone fruits, citrus brightness, and a beautifully syrupy body. Amazing on its own as an espresso or try in a cortado.We got our start in 2012 by roasting incredible coffee, sourced from sustainable relationships with producers around the world, out of our Williamsburg, Brooklyn cafe & roastery. Since then we've been working hard to expand the Partners experience across a product line-up that features things like cold brew cans, subscriptions, and rotating single-origin coffees. We can't wait to see what the future holds, though we believe it'll be great because of friends like you. As each of our bags proudly states: we're only as great as the sum of our partners.Producers - ASORCAFE & Suke QutoElevation - 1,700 - 1,930 metersRegions - San Antonio, Cauca, Colombia and Guji, Oromia, EthiopiaVariety - Caturra, Colombia, Typica and HeirloomProcess - Wet-ProcessedFarm Relationship – YesRoast Level – 76Brew Methods - Espresso/MokapotCold Brew – YesGood with milk? - Yes

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: “On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It’s visceral." Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A smooth medium-bodied cup with subtle notes of sweet citrus and bittersweet chocolate. Everything we love in the fine coffees grown in this part of the world. The coffee hails from high elevation organic farms across the Americas, from Guatemala to Colombia, where superior terroir and carefully honed growing practices create some of the best beans in the world. Organic farmers in this region are committed to preserving the beauty and richness of the land that is both their home and livelihood. Alma de la Tierra, or "Soul of the Earth", honors this worthy intention and the hard work required to realize it.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Some have described Alfred Peet as the “big bang” of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America’s expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet’s pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason’s one-of-a-kind taste, you’ll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason’s but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It’s the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Great coffee brings friends and neighbors together like nothing else. That's why we created this medium roast to pay tribute to the time-honored pastime of lingering in the café, casually sipping an expertly brewed cup over conversation. The three Latin American coffees in this carefully crafted blend were selected for their balance and brightness, and the roast fine-tuned to brew the perfect medium-bodied cup. We decided to name it after our third café, opened by Alfred Peet in 1980 on Domingo Avenue in Berkeley, in the shadow of the Claremont Hotel. For more than three decades, Peet's regulars have gathered here to enjoy hand-crafted drinks and the camaraderie they inspire. And that's something worth commemorating. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: �On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It's visceral."

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's French Roast encompasses our favorite beans for this deepest roast. These beans are from the leading Latin American origins, such as Guatemala and Colombia, where high altitudes enable coffee cherry to mature more slowly, becoming denser, harder, and packed with flavor. These inherently bright, juicy beans retain their bold complexity under the heat of a deep roast. To grow organic coffee is a commitment to environmental stewardship despite an inevitably smaller yield. Where conventional farming benefits from carefully formulated nutrients, organic farming is local and labor intensive, with resources like natural compost, fashioned on the farm. It's more work to produce less coffee and we're happy to support the extra effort. Enjoy this meticulously grown, deep-roasted coffee that is a bold dedication to flavor, farm, and future.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: In Colombia, luminosa means "shining or bright". Peet's Luminosa Breakfast Blend Light Roast Coffee layers subtle sweetness from Colombia with just the right touch of Ethiopia floral aromatics, a pair we knew would go perfectly together. We started with a coffee from the Huila region in Colombia's highlands, a place where beans are cultivated over 4,500 feet and known for their smooth, sweet character. Then to Ethiopia, coffee's birthplace, where unique varieties yield exquisite coffees with delicate aromas. Formerly known as Colombia Luminosa, we approached this bright blend, our first light roast, as we do all our coffees: carefully select the very best beans, then hand roast them in small batches to achieve their utmost flavor.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Big Bang Medium Roast Coffee is our signature medium roast created to celebrate Alfred Peet and our 50th anniversary. Some have described Alfred Peet as the "big bang" of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America's expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet's pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason's one-of-a-kind taste, you'll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason's but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It's the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: PLANT STRONG Organic Firehouse Chili delivers bold, hearty comfort food made with simple organic ingredients and powerful plant-based nutrition. This ready-to-eat vegan chili features a satisfying blend of organic navy beans, black beans, red kidney beans, tomatoes, corn, peppers, and smoky spices for rich flavor with a mildly spicy finish. Each 14.5 oz carton provides 20g of plant-based protein and 10g of fiber, making it a filling and nourishing option for lunch, dinner, post-workout meals, or quick pantry-friendly convenience. PLANTSTRONG Firehouse Chili is USDA Organic, Non-GMO, contains zero added sugar, and is made without seed oils. Designed for busy lifestyles, this shelf-stable plant-based chili heats quickly in minutes on the stovetop or in the microwave. Enjoy it straight from the bowl or customize it with toppings like avocado, salsa, cilantro, lime, or hot sauce. It also pairs perfectly with rice, baked potatoes, greens, pasta, or tortilla chips. Whether you are looking for a wholesome vegan chili, a high-protein pantry staple, or a flavorful plant-based comfort meal, PLANT STRONG Organic Firehouse Chili brings hearty flavor and clean ingredients together in every carton.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The story behind PHNB begins in the mid-90s. Several ranchers got together to discuss the current trends in the beef industry and how to add value to beef products. They discovered that they were all experiencing the same confusion. Why is it that I am producing top quality cattle and yet all I hear at grocery stores and restaurants is that beef isn't as good as it used to be? As it turned out, the cattle that came from the ranches of Wheeler County were being lost in the mix of cattle from all over North America. Their cattle were being blended into pens that held cattle of lower quality. This beef, in turn, was being sent to the market and restaurants, resulting in unhappy consumers. Those ranchers decided to do something. They formed a corporation called Painted Hills Premium Beef, Inc. the groundwork for Painted Hills Natural Beef. The Natural Beef name was born out of a desire to better reflect the focus of the organization.  Painted Hills Natural beef is raised with No Added Hormones, No Antibiotics, Pasture Raised and fed a 100% Vegetarian Diet. Our cattle are never fed animal by-products of any kind. This is beef you can trust.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Styling causes damage. We get it. But we also know you love to switch up your hair styles, so we're here to help you do that - without worrying about the damage. The ultimate way to protect hair from styling damage is with SheaMoisture Bond Repair Leave-In. Once you leave it in, you'll never want to leave it behind. How could you when it delivers the ultimate hydration boost, on top of your SheaMoisture Bond Repair Collection routine, that preps and protects your hair to wear any style you like. It's the secret step for worry-free styling that leaves in tons of moisture and leaves out the damage. Our hair strengthening formula infused with Hydroplex Technology, Amino Blend and Amla Oil knows just what your damaged hair needs and restores essential proteins that help repair broken hair bonds. Over time, this builds up your hair's strength so day by day it grows healthier-looking and softer with less breakage. And strong hair is the foundation for strong style. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: In our family, a dinner party is not complete without tortilla chips, salsa, and guacamole. Our grain free chips are dairy-free, powered by avocado oil, and made with natural ingredients (and lots of love!). With a selection of flavors like Sea Salt, Lime, Nacho, Fuego, Ranch, Sal y Limón, and No Salt, we hope there’s a flavor that speaks to everyone. Delicious as a solo act or in queso, bean dip, or hot sauce—but the real magic is when our tortilla chips are enjoyed with family and friends around the table. Our Grain Free Tortilla Chips come in all different flavors, shapes and sizes! Our five-ounce tortilla chips are large format, light and crispy cantina-style tortilla chips, while our four-ounce tortilla chips are smaller, thicker triangles full of seasoning: • Sea Salt (5oz) • Lime (5oz) • No Salt (5oz) • Nacho (5oz) • Fuego (4oz) • Ranch (4oz) • Sal y Limón (4oz) • Nacho (4oz)

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Say hello to the pour that gives you more with Silk Protein Complete Plant Protein Milk. A high protein plant based milk, Silk soy protein milk contains 13g complete plant protein per serving, 50% more than regular dairy milk,* to help keep you full and help support muscle health. Unlike some other plant based protein sources, Silk Protein is a complete plant protein, meaning it delivers all 9 essential amino acids your body can’t make on its own in adequate amounts, as well as 3g dietary fiber per serving. And with 50% less sugar than dairy milk per serving,** you can enjoy all that protein and great taste with less sugar. This high protein milk is free of dairy, gluten, carrageenan, cholesterol, artificial colors and artificial flavors. Whether you’re turning any cereal into protein cereal, making protein shakes and smoothies or drinking straight out of a glass, Silk Protein Milk provides nutrition you need with a taste you will love. *Silk Protein Original: 13g protein/cup; reduced fat milk: 8g protein/cup. **Silk Protein Original: 4g sugar/cup; reduced fat milk: 11g sugar/cup.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Chicken and Wild Rice Soup. This organic soup has tender organic chicken, wild and brown rice and a variety of organically grown vegetables. Parsley and other seasonings round out the flavor of this gluten free soup, bringing a classic recipe to a whole new level of goodness. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings or pair soups with a salad, sandwich or wrap. USDA Certified Organic and made with non-GMO ingredients, this organic chicken soup contains 11 grams of protein per can and is made with no MSG, high fructose corn syrup, artificial colors or artificial flavors. To prepare, simply pour it into a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, heat until hot, stir and enjoy. Every spoonful of our microwave soup is satisfying to the last drop. The soup can is recyclable for easy disposal. In addition to our Chicken and Wild Rice, we offer Chicken Noodle, Vegetable Lentil and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Spicy Chicken Noodle Soup. This USDA Certified Organic soup is consciously crafted with non-GMO ingredients, including chicken meat with no antibiotics, egg noodles, carrots, and celery. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Stonyfield Organic YoBaby Whole Milk Baby Yogurt is made perfect for tiny tummies. Created with parents in mind, our 4-ounce yummy yogurts in banana and strawberry are made with real fruit and Vitamin D, to help nourish your baby. They're great for your baby's first foods starting at the 6-month stage. The protein and calcium in our whole milk yogurt cups help support brain health when consumed regularly as part of a balanced diet. Our whole milk yogurt cups are made with no added sweeteners. Like all Stonyfield Organic products, YoBaby yogurt cups are USDA organic certified. That means they’re made without the use of toxic persistent pesticides, antibiotics, artificial growth hormones or genetically modified organisms (GMOs) — things you don’t want to worry about, especially in baby food. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Green, potent, and microscopic, chlorella is a single-celled freshwater algae celebrated for its dense nutrient profile and detox-supporting potential. Sunfood’s formula uses broken-cell-wall processing to disrupt the tough outer shell of the algae cells, making its internal nutrients more bioavailable. We are proud to process our chlorella into pressed tablets without the use of additional fillers or caking agents, just pure chlorella powder. The emerald green hue comes from chlorophyll, a compound known for purifying properties. With a combination of protein, iron, beta-carotene, and B vitamins, this algae tablet supports detox pathways, cellular health, and overall vitality. Whether you’re seeking to support your body’s natural cleansing systems or simply add a potent green superfood to your daily regimen, these tablets give you a concentrated boost in a compact form.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A silicone-free, gentle conditioner for a good hair day every day! This fragrance-free formula is made with calendula, aloe and other naturally derived ingredients that leave hair soft and silky! Tear-free and gentle enough for lil' ones but great for the whole fam! whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Enjoy the sun with your baby year-round with Thinkbaby Safe Sunscreen SPF 50+ which is made with highly efficacious, gentle ingredients. Protect your little one with this zinc oxide mineral sunscreen which is effective for infants over 6 months and gentle on sensitive skin. Our mineral-based formulas go on smooth and absorb easily without leaving you feeling sticky or goopy. Ensures broad-spectrum protection that begins instantly with no unpleasant fragrance or chemicals. You can apply this sun cream to all areas that will be exposed to sunlight, including behind the ears, neck, hands, feet, and scalp. Reapply every two hours or more as needed. With a water resistance of up to 80 minutes, your little munchkin is allowed some protected fun in the sun. This non-aerosol formulation is free from harmful chemicals. No PABA, parabens, phthalates, BPA, oxybenzone, avobenzone, petroleum, gluten or dairy. No animal by-products or testing. We are guided by the 'Precautionary Principle' for every product we bring to market. With over a decade of leadership in product safety, Thinkbaby Thinksport works with leading institutions and scientists to develop products that are both safe for your children and safe for the environment your kids live in.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee—the perfect blend of sweet and salty indulgence! This fan-favorite bar combines 42% dark milk chocolate with crunchy pretzel pieces and a sweet toffee crunch. Each bite is an irresistible combination of rich dark milk chocolate, salty pretzel pieces, and the sweet, chewy goodness of toffee. Wrapped in a vibrant purple wrapper, it’s a candy that’s as fun to look at as it is to eat! At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should do more than just taste great—it should make a difference. That’s why our Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the 42% dark milk chocolate, the crunch of the pretzels, and the sweet, buttery flavor of the toffee. Whether you’re enjoying a sweet snack, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of creamy dark milk chocolate, crunchy pretzels, and sweet toffee, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s changing the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony’s Chocolonely is more than just chocolate; it’s a mission driven brand that seeks to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. With Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa, each bite you take can help combat the widespread issues of child labor, forced labor, and unsustainable farming practices. By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a sustainable, ethical, and transparent supply chain that prioritizes farmers and the environment. Our chocolate bars and chocolate chunks come in a wide range of irresistible flavors, perfect for snacks or desserts. From Milk Chocolate to Dark Chocolate Almond Sea Salt, each variety is crafted with care to provide a truly indulgent experience. For those who crave a mix of everything, our Tiny Tony Variety Pack offers 14 individually wrapped chunks in 6 delicious flavors, including Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt, Honey Almond Nougat, Almond Sea Salt, and Dark Milk Chocolate Pretzel Toffee—a delight for every taste. These chocolate bars make the perfect gift, whether for a birthday, holiday, or special occasion. And with chocolate this good, there’s no reason to wait! At Tony’s, we also focus on the long term—we work directly with cocoa cooperatives for at least five years to build lasting relationships and create sustainable change. This stability allows farmers to invest in improved farming practices, increase their yields, and reduce deforestation. Tony’s even implements a Child Labor Monitoring and Remediation System to encourage that all workers are regarded with fairness and respect. By purchasing Tony’s Chocolonely, you’re choosing chocolate made with clean ingredients and supporting a movement that demands transparency in the cocoa industry. So whether you’re grabbing a quick snack, enjoying a cozy evening with chocolate desserts, or looking for a sweet gift, know that Tony’s is the chocolate you can feel good about. Join us in the fight for a fairer, more sustainable world. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony's Chocolonely Milk Chocolate Bar is a silky-smooth and downright delicious 32% milk chocolate bar that's changing the chocolate industry. These vibrant red-wrapped wonders are made with traceable cocoa and exist to support the wellbeing of cocoa farmers and their families. Our all-natural bars were Fairtrade Certified from the start and made with outstanding non-GMO ingredients. You’ll notice that each bar has a dynamic, uneven pattern that makes it a bit difficult to share equally. With these unequal divisions, we present an important story about the inequality along the chocolate supply chain. Share a bar of our outstanding milk chocolate and in doing so, help us share our recipe for slave-free chocolate. Includes one 1.8 oz. Milk Chocolate Bar. Right now, slaves are working on cocoa farms in West Africa. Many of them are children. Tony's Chocolonely exists to change that. Our vision is 100% slave-free chocolate. Not just our chocolate, but all chocolate worldwide. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example to show the world chocolate can be made differently. The more people choose slave-free and share our story, the sooner 100% slave-free becomes the norm in chocolate. The choice is yours. Are you in?

This bar is made with rich 32% cocoa and creamy milk chocolate, offering a perfect balance of sweetness and cocoa flavor. Every bite delivers a melt-in-your-mouth experience that’s simple, delicious, and utterly satisfying. At Tony’s, we believe chocolate should do more than just taste good—it should make a difference. That’s why our Milk Chocolate Bar with 32% Cocoa is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a tasty chocolate bar; you’re supporting a movement that promotes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for cocoa farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support our farmers to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. This Milk Chocolate Bar with 32% Cocoa is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the smooth, creamy texture of the milk chocolate, delivering a rich cocoa flavor that’s perfectly sweetened. It’s a classic that never goes out of style. Whether you’re indulging yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Milk Chocolate Bar with 32% Cocoa is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate balance of creamy milk chocolate and Fairtrade cocoa, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—indulge with a bar that’s as flavorful as it is meaningful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s changing the cocoa industry for the better.

We use Tony’s 5 Sourcing Principles to make sure the cocoa we use is sourced responsibly, and that the farmers who grow it can earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Milk Chocolate Caramel Cookie Bar is a perfect example of how Tony’s blends exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the creamy richness of the milk chocolate, the crunchy satisfaction of the cookie bits, and the chewy, buttery caramel that ties everything together. It’s a delight that’s as fun as it is flavorful—and one you can feel good about enjoying. Whether you’re enjoying yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Milk Chocolate Caramel Cookie Bar is sure to satisfy every craving. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Milk Chocolate Bar with Caramel and Sea Salt—a mouthwatering combination of creamy milk chocolate, rich caramel, and a hint of sea salt. This indulgent bar brings together the richness of milk chocolate with the sweet and buttery flavor of caramel, perfectly balanced by a touch of sea salt to elevate the sweetness. Each bite is a delicious harmony of flavors that is sure to satisfy your sweet and salty cravings. At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should be more than just a candy—it should make a difference. That’s why our Milk Chocolate Bar with Caramel and Sea Salt is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Milk Chocolate Bar with Caramel and Sea Salt is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the creaminess of the milk chocolate, followed by the sweet richness of caramel, and finished off with the savory touch of sea salt to complete the flavor. Together, they create an indulgent delight that’s as satisfying as it is delicious. Whether you’re enjoying yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Milk Chocolate Bar with Caramel and Sea Salt is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of creamy milk chocolate, rich caramel, and a hint of sea salt, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—introduce yourself to a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony’s Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt & Cookie Mix Snackable Bits bring together the perfect blend of rich, creamy milk chocolate, crunchy caramel, a touch of sea salt, and buttery cookie bits in one delicious, bite-sized piece. Whether you’re snacking at home, at work, or on the go, these snackable bites are the perfect balance of sweet, salty, and crunchy—just what you need to satisfy those cravings. The smooth milk chocolate melts in your mouth, while the caramel adds a rich sweetness, and the sea salt gives it the perfect savory kick. The addition of cookie bits brings the perfect crunch, making these bites a satisfying indulgence that’s hard to resist. At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should not only taste great but also make a positive impact. That’s why every bite of our Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt & Cookie Mix Snackable Bits is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. When you choose Tony’s, you’re helping support farmers to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. We’re committed to creating a sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry, and every purchase you make helps us continue that mission. The Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt & Cookie Mix Snackable Bits are perfect for when you need a quick snack, a little dessert to share, or a sweet indulgence during a break. These convenient, individually wrapped bites make it easy to enjoy a delicious chocolate experience wherever you are. Packed with flavor and texture, they offer the perfect mix of creamy milk chocolate, rich caramel, the savory touch of sea salt, and the delightful crunch of cookie bits. Whether you’re sharing with friends, keeping a bag at your desk, or enjoying them during a movie night, these snackable bits are sure to become a favorite. Tony’s Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt & Cookie Mix Snackable Bits are the snack you’ve been waiting for!

Whether you’re indulging yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, The Milk Hazelnut Bar is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of creamy chocolate and crunchy nuts, all in one delicious, satisfying bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Get ready for a campfire classic, now in snackable form! Tony’s S’mores Mix Lil' Bits are the perfect snack for anyone craving that nostalgic s’mores flavor. Packed with fluffy, melt-in-your-mouth marshmallows, crispy graham cracker pieces, coated in rich milk chocolate, every bite delivers the ultimate balance of sweet, crunchy, and chocolatey goodness. Whether you’re at home, work, or on the go, these convenient, bite-sized nibbles make it easy to enjoy the taste of s’mores anytime, anywhere. Perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth, sharing with friends, or packing for an outdoor adventure, these S’mores Snackable Bits are the ideal snack for every occasion. At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should do more than just taste amazing—it should make a positive impact. That’s why every bite of our S’mores Snackable Bits is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. When you choose Tony’s, you’re not just indulging in a delicious candy; you’re supporting a movement that supports cocoa farmers to get paid a living income and work in fair, safe conditions. We are committed to creating a more sustainable, ethical, and transparent chocolate industry, and every purchase helps drive this mission forward. Tony’s S’mores Snackable Bits are perfect for everyone who loves the classic campfire tradition, but without the need for a fire. Whether you’re taking a break during work, hanging out at home, or looking for a sweet snack on the go, these delicious bites are easy to grab and indulge in. They offer a delightful texture with the chewiness of the marshmallow, the crunch of the graham crackers, and the creamy, smooth richness of Tony’s signature milk chocolate. And be warned—these irresistible snackable bits tend to run out quickly, so grab a bag (or two). Introduce yourself to a snack that’s as fun as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony’s Rainbow Tasting Pack is the perfect way to experience the best of Tony’s chocolate in one colorful and fun package. This variety pack features 6 of our most beloved flavors, offering something for every chocolate lover. From the smooth, creamy texture of Milk Chocolate to the indulgent sweetness of Milk Caramel Sea Salt, this pack has all the delicious options you crave. The Milk Chocolate Nougat delivers a chewy, satisfying bite, while the Dark Almond Sea Salt bar brings a perfect balance of bold, rich dark chocolate with crunchy almonds and a touch of sea salt. If you’re a fan of deep cocoa, the 70% Dark Chocolate is the perfect choice for a more intense chocolate experience. All these bars come in our bright, cheerful rainbow packaging, making it a fun gift or a vibrant addition to your snack stash. At Tony’s, we believe that great chocolate should make a positive impact. That’s why each bar is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa, supporting cocoa farmers to get paid a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a movement for a more sustainable, ethical, and transparent chocolate industry. Whether you’re sharing with friends, yourself, or looking for a thoughtful gift, the Rainbow Tasting Pack offers a wide variety of flavors that will satisfy every chocolate craving. The fun, colorful packaging makes it ideal for gifting during any celebration, and with its mix of classic milk and dark chocolate options, everyone can find their favorite. So why not indulge yourself or someone you love to a colorful and exciting experience that does good for the world as well as for your taste buds? With every purchase of the Rainbow Tasting Pack, you’re not just enjoying the finest chocolate—you’re contributing to a fairer chocolate industry.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s The Everything Bar—the chocolate bar that truly has it all! This indulgence is packed with 32% milk chocolate, caramel, almond nougat, pretzel, and a touch of sea salt. Each bite offers a perfect blend of creamy, crunchy, salty, and sweet flavors that come together in one irresistible bar. It’s the ultimate chocolate experience for anyone who loves bold Belgian chocolate and a bit of everything! At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should be more than just a tasty snack—it should make a difference. That’s why we’re on a mission to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. Every bar of The Everything Bar is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Everything Bar is a prime example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the milk chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of the pretzels, the sweet indulgence of the caramel, and the chewy delight of the almond nougat. A hint of sea salt ties it all together, creating a harmonious balance of flavors that’s simply unforgettable. Whether you’re indulging yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, The Everything Bar is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate balance of flavors, all in one indulgent, delicious chocolate bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—introduce yourself to a bar that’s as fun as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: We believe what goes on your body is as important as what goes in it. That's why our beauty and body care standards go beyond typical "clean beauty" claims. We ban 240+ ingredients commonly used in beauty and body products, including parabens, phthalates, formaldehyde donors, oxybenzone, PFAS and EDTA. Our experts review the latest research on beauty and body care ingredients for many factors including possible impacts on the environment and human health. Taking the name JASON, which means "Healer" in Greek, they rejected harsh, risky chemicals. Instead, they blended simple, healing ingredients to create soaps and lotions crafted according to the JASON Code of Honor: 1. Select safe, gentle and effective ingredients 2. Rigorously test every formula to ensure safety and efficacy 3. Never test on animals 4. Constantly innovate and improve. for over 50 years the makers of JASON products have kept this code and committed themselves to the idea of wholesome personal care solutions that are safe for us, our families, and our planet.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The Yerba Prima Tampico Skin Brush is a wonderful, revitalizing health and beauty aid. Removing the top layer of dead skin and stimulating the circulation of blood feeding the skin are essential for maintaining youthful, glowing and supple skin. Skin Brushing has been used throughout the world for centuries, and is making its way back into popularity. Dry skin brushing is one of the best ways to cleanse the skin without removing the protective mantle of acid and oils. It gently and effectively removes the top layer of dead skin cells with its build-up of dirt and acid, and deeply cleanses the pores. Skin brushing is one of the most powerful ways to cleanse the lymphatic system. Waste material is carried away from the cells by the blood and the lymph. Skin brushing stimulates the release of this material from the cells near the surface of the body. Eventually, most of the toxins along with their carrier cells, primarily lymphocytes, find their way to the colon for elimination. Skin brushing is also used by beauty salons as part of a program for removing cellulite. Skin brushing is most effective with an all-natural vegetable fiber brush, such as the Tampico Skin Brush. Make sure the brush isn t made of synthetic fiber since this can irritate the skin. A long handle is also helpful for reaching the back and entire body.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Zollipops, The Clean Teeth Pops, are no ordinary suckers. They are supercharged with smile friendly ingredients. Each Zollipop contains erythritol, a favorite with dentists! Zollipops help reduce the acidity and raise the ph in your mouth. High acidity contributes to tooth decay and by reducing acidity we can help teeth re-mineralize faster making them stronger and harder. Zollipops were created by Alina Morse, an innovative young girl in Michigan who decided she wanted to create a sugar free candy that tastes great AND is good for your teeth. Alina set off to find and incorporate the best possible ingredients with delicious flavors. You'll love the taste and the smooth, clean feeling Zollipops deliver. Zollipops are made with an amazing new formula that does not melt or get sticky. We offer longer lasting flavors and an extended shelf life. Zollipops are the perfect after you eat treat for a healthy smile! Store them in your purse or backpack and enjoy one after every meal. Up to 3 pops per day. 3 pops are only 1 point on weight watchers so enjoy guilt-free! Packaging graphics may vary. This product is filled by weight, not by piece count. Piece count may vary.

recommendations.title: Resolve category uncertainty without discarding verified offers
recommendations.detail: 557 products still need category evidence. Their valid offers remain browsable under Needs category review; they are excluded from automatic meal matching.

recommendations.title: Recover source data before guessing from images
recommendations.detail: 5 products have no image-classifier row. Retailer product types, descriptions and explicit product forms take precedence over image guesses.

recommendations.title: Prefer source-backed rules over broad keyword guessing
recommendations.detail: Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.

recommendations.title: Use gold labels as training data
recommendations.detail: Pick representative products from repeated failed brands and product families. One good label can help a whole cluster through the local text model.
